raw_html: [[Inspiring Echoes]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Inspiring Echoes]]:''' When a bard wields this item, [[Anthem (item enchantment)|Anthem]] abilities that restore Bard songs over time restore them 40% faster (for example, an ability that restores a Song every 5 minutes would restore one song per 3 minutes instead).
